csp.text: At Rimewind Keep, as the Thaw proceeded, Gendrin ordered spells on Heidar's advice that temporarily halted it, plunging the continent back into winter.
Heidar found Phyrexian etchings in the keep's depths and went mad, murdering Gendrin and taking command.
The cult reanimated Phyrexian war-beasts, and when Lovisa Coldeyes' Balduvians stormed Rimewind, Heidar activated them, causing a massacre, until Garza Zol's assassins killed the mad Heidar.
